15th August Independence day special: One of the leading comedians in the country, Zakir Khan, joins as 'Guest in the newsroom'. Zakir Khan's career, how things are done behind a stand up comedy and many other things are discussed in this show. He tells, how he performs on stage and deals with audience. He explains why he does not perform political jokes. Watch video to know more.
